verdict.rationale: Anytype's built-in Web Publishing turns any Object into a public static HTML page on a personal any.org subdomain with a single Publish click inside the app, so publishing selected notes without leaving the app is documented. The evidence describes publishing per Object, not a navigable multi-page site. Nothing shows that links between published notes resolve to other published pages. Missing for 10: evidence that links between published notes work, browsable site-level navigation (a digital garden rather than individual pages), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
